story: Ed Gilroy Sr. founded this business in the Wyoming Valley in 1972. More than fifty years later his son Ed Jr. runs it, and still turns up to do estimates himself. We have served over 10,000 customers across Wilkes-Barre and the surrounding towns, we hold an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau, and we are an Owens Corning Platinum Preferred Contractor — one of the few in the area certified to offer a 50-year material and labor warranty. We have never asked a customer to pay before the work was finished, and we do not intend to start.
